speaker: abel_garnish
text: Scene by scene from the pasteboard, masters, and take your rolls as I come to your names. Mr Burbage needs none. He has been the king since June.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I have it in my doublet, Abel. The hole is at the fold where the crown goes. Call the rest.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Mr Phillips, Bolingbroke. Mr Heminges, York. George Bryan, Northumberland. Will Sly, Mowbray in the lists.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Bolingbroke. A weight of parchment for Harry Hereford.

speaker: john_heminges
text: York stays on his legs, by the look of the rules. I have him.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Mr Pope. The gardener.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Eighteen lines and an apricock tree. One strip, John, and a tree to bind up.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The pile goes down. The last roll is the Groom's, for John Sincler.

speaker: will_kemp
text: There's none for me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No, Will.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A king play! With no fool in it! Who's to tell them when to breathe?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no place in it, Will, where a man could laugh and the king still stand.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then it wants one the worse. I'd have got you a laugh at the deposing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Master has cut the deposing.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Has he so? Then he and I are served alike.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You have the jig after, Will. The whole stage, and nobody's lines in your mouth.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A groat in settlement of a pound. I will take the groat.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Eighteen lines, Will, and an apricock tree. Leave them their dignity.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The first act, from the king's entrance with old Gaunt. Clear the doors.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: From the top, then. Plain, so we can hear where the month has worn it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: From the top, Dick. Let the words walk before we make them run.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I am at the door when you want Bolingbroke.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And York when the book calls him. Not before.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I can wait for my tree. It is not in this act.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I can wait longer than any of you. I have no lines to miss.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Masters. The first act. The book is open.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Open it, Abel. We are here.
